scene.bubble: My friend Emma moved to another city, so now we write real letters — with stamps, stickers and secret jokes!

data.text: Dear Valentina, thank you for your letter and the drawing of Luna! My news: our new flat is on the fifth floor and from my window I can see the port with its red boats. My new school is nice — my teacher has a guitar, like your friend Oliver! I have one new friend. Her name is Paula and she also loves reading. Please write soon and tell me: did Erik finish the confetti machine? Love from Emma.
